The season marked the Wildcats' 51st season at [[McKale Center]] in [[Tucson, Arizona]], and their first season as members of the [[Big 12 Conference men's basketball|Big 12 Conference]]. The Arizona Wildcats drew an average home attendance of 14,058, the 18th-highest of all college basketball teams.https://stats.ncaa.org/rankings/change_sport_year_div ==Previous season== {{main|2023–24 Arizona Wildcats men's basketball team}} The [[2023–24 Arizona Wildcats men's basketball team|Wildcats]] finished the [[2023–24 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2023–24 season]] 27–9, 15–5 in [[2023–24 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball season|Pac-12 Conference]] play, winning their 18th and final Pac-12 regular season title and overall 1 seed in the [[2024 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament|Pac-12 tournament]]. recruiting class rankings yet.}} === Red and Blue game === Arizona announced on August 20, 2024 that the Wildcat cats would host their annual Red-Blue Game at the [[McKale Center]] on October 4, 2024. [[Richard Jefferson]] and [[Channing Frye]] are serving as the hosts for the game for the second year in a row.{{Cite web |title=Two Dates Announced for 2024 Red-Blue Showcase |url=https://arizonawildcats.com/news/2024/8/20/mens-basketball-two-dates-announced-for-2024-red-blue-showcase.aspx}} The game is being streamed on [[ESPN+]]. The night began with a three-point contest featuring [[Carter Bryant (basketball)|Carter Bryant]], Anthony Dell'Orso, Liam Lloyd and [[Caleb Love]]. Dell'Orso and Love made the finals with Love winning the shootout making 17 of 25 three pointers. The second event of the night featured a dunk contest featureTobe Awaka, [[Jaden Bradley]], [[Carter Bryant (basketball)|Carter Bryant]] and [[KJ Lewis]]. Bryant and Lewis advanced to the finals with Carter Bryant winning with a total score of 59 points out of 60. The dunk contest was judged by Jefferson, Frye and former player Corey Williams. The night ended with the team splitting into two squads, Team Blue & Team Red. Team Red defeated Team Blue, 47–44.
